title: Container Vent Upgrade Guide
description: Explore ventilation upgrades for your shipping container.

steps.title: Upgrade Your Container Ventilation
steps.instruction: Follow the steps to verify fit, airflow, and vent size before cutting your roof.

expandable.title: Why ventilation matters
expandable.content: Shipping containers trap heat and moisture. Proper ventilation prevents condensation, rust, and overheating.

steps.title: Ventilation Rule
steps.instruction: Recommended ventilation is 1 square foot per 150 square feet of space.

steps.title: Measure Roof Rib Height
steps.instruction: Measure the roof rib to confirm the vent adapter will seal correctly.

steps.title: Verify Vent Fit
steps.instruction: Confirm the adapter plate matches your roof corrugation pattern.

input.label: My roof ribs match the adapter pattern

expandable.title: Why this matters
expandable.content: If the ribs do not match the adapter profile the vent may not seal properly, which could allow water intrusion.

steps.title: Check Airflow
steps.instruction: Good ventilation requires intake and exhaust airflow.

input.label: My container will have intake airflow (vents or gaps)

expandable.title: Airflow explanation
expandable.content: Roof vents remove hot air, but fresh air must enter the container for circulation.

steps.title: Choose Vent Size
steps.instruction: Most containers use a 12-inch turbine vent.

steps.title: Your Ventilation Plan
steps.instruction: Based on your selections, here is the recommended setup.
